label: Logo band (a line of customer logos sliding through)
description: A horizontal band of customer logos that slides steadily through the frame -- the social-proof beat over the person ('hundreds of teams'). Give it the logos as image URLs or as text wordmarks -- ONLY customers the brief names, never invented ones (with none named, do not cast it); it repeats them to fill the width and drifts them left at a steady pace from `at`, holding to the cut (or `hold` seconds). Rides over the take at the upper third (`y`, default 20% from the top); a translucent plate keeps it legible on footage. Full-frame overlay -- it places itself. Example: {"logos":[{"text":"Nestlé"},{"src":"/assets/.../gamma.png"},{"text":"Ancestry"}],"at":0.4}.

logos.label: [{src} image logos or {text} wordmarks], four or more

hold.label: Seconds on screen (0 = to the cut)

plate.label: Translucent plate behind the band (default true)
